captions.tiktok: Over 1400 years, not one letter of the Qur'an has changed - memorized word for word by millions across the earth. Allah is al-Hafiz, the Preserver. Qur'an 15:9.
captions.shorts: Al-Hafiz, the Preserver - Allah Himself promised to guard the Qur'an, and He has. Qur'an 15:9.
captions.reels: Not one letter changed in 1400 years. Allah is al-Hafiz, the Preserver of His book. Qur'an 15:9.

segments.text: A single book, held in the hearts of millions, word for word the same.
One of the names of Allah is al-Hafiz, the Preserver. And He made a promise about His book.
Over fourteen hundred years have passed, yet not one letter of the Qur'an has changed.
Children who have never met, on every continent, recite it in the very same words.
Close the book, and the whole of it still lives, memorized, inside them.
Indeed, it is We who sent down the message, and indeed, We will be its guardian.
segments.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

segments.text: No other book has been kept so perfectly, for so long. He is al-Hafiz. What He preserves, nothing can touch.
